purpose: Falsify or strengthen NUM05 source-blind A-B-A memory benefit by comparing to matched Bayesian change-point/regime filters on disjoint synthetic numerical causal families, nonperiodic action/quadrant schedules, drifting source times and cold return.
hypothesis: NUM05 reduces separately scored late unfamiliar and familiar cold-return prequential 3-output MSE compared with the strongest completely fitted posterior regime-memory and exact run-length control without access to private law or change-point identity. Exact retained bytes, public-gated recall and bounded resources required.

source_and_splits.isolation: new synthetic-only, stdlib; never call protected original-world source; same exact public event stream/observation/action/target/terminal per arm; all forecasts before updates; fixed source content and SHA must be independently admitted before sealed use
source_and_splits.public_observation: two finite numeric coordinates plus successor and scalar reward; no hidden family/true phase/task label
source_and_splits.source_family: presealed source-native independent alternative numerical laws, including nonlinear within-quadrant change, cross-coordinate interactions and action-specific effects; no copying/relabeling NUM05 A/B coefficients; no oracle label provided to models
source_and_splits.schedule: seeded permutation of equal 5-action/4-quadrant coverage within randomized blocks; A-B-A boundaries vary across source cohorts; no fixed 20-event or action-index clock available to learner
source_and_splits.old_bank_retention: read first-bank content hash at boundary 1 and boundary 2; verify cold restore and byte-identical full checkpoint
source_and_splits.no_replay: zero repeats after first admitted original scored execution of each cohort; no post-hoc tuning on held results

arms.candidate: unchanged NUM05 NumericRegimeMemory, max 2 banks, max 512 public rows
arms.posterior_two_bank: independent conjugate normal known-noise soft evidence assignment to two public action/quadrant regime banks, Markov hazard, public observation likelihood only
arms.run_length_bocpd: independent exact bounded Bayesian online change point run-length filter with action/quadrant posterior predictive consequences and retained archival return hypothesis
arms.capacity_parity: report exact model bytes, fit/forecast process CPU and RSS; candidate and Bayesian comparators limited to <=2 persistent regimes and <=512 public observations; no hidden phase information or oracle predictions
arms.fitting: fully fit Bayesian hazard [0.005,0.02,0.08], observed noise [0.04,0.15], prior std [0.5,1.0] on FIT only; select by mean FIT+validation full prequential MSE; freeze winners before any HELD or null scored evaluation; other arms use preregistered settings

evaluation.metric: prequential MSE of (successor_x-observation_x,successor_y-observation_y,reward), divide by 3; score strictly before witness updates
evaluation.windows: for each variable t1,t2 late B=[t1+80,t2); cold return A=[t2+32,448); report each separately and equal-weight pooled per trial
evaluation.primary: per HELD seed NUM05 pooled MSE must be >=0.005 absolute AND >=10% relative lower than the best fitted comparator on that seed; all 3 held seeds must satisfy
evaluation.guards: no later-B score more than +0.01 worse than best control in that window; no cold-A score more than +0.01 worse than best control; old bank retained byte exact; >=0.80 old bank usage last 48 return observations; cold checkpoint replay exact; stationary null has no additional committed regime in NUM05 and no >0.80 posterior mass of new bank after warmup for Bayesian comparator
evaluation.scientific_status: synthetic held research feasibility only; SCIENTIFIC_PASS requires separately authorized original unfamiliar source family, independent witnessed evaluation, reproduction and compute parity
evaluation.fail: any leak, changed frozen source, missing matched control, guard failure or resource mismatch is NO_GO/INVALID, never retrofit thresholds or rerun consumed seeds

authority.execution_authorized: fixture-only source-independent engineering tests; no reserved fit/valid/held/null generator calls absent separate native source-owner admission
